message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build and deploy rules_android Stardoc

on:
  # Allows you to run this workflow manually from the Actions tab
  workflow_dispatch:

# Sets permissions of the GITHUB_TOKEN to allow deployment to GitHub Pages
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# Allow only one concurrent deployment, skipping runs queued between the run in-progress and latest queued.
# However, do NOT cancel in-progress runs as we want to allow these production deployments to complete.
concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # Build job
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Cache Bazel dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/bazel
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-bazel-${{ hashFiles('MODULE.bazel', 'WORKSPACE') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-bazel-
      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v4
      - name: Install pandoc
        run: sudo apt install pandoc
      - name: Build Stardoc with Bazel
        run: |
          bazel build //stardoc:stardoc.md --workspace_status_command='echo STABLE_GIT_COMMIT $(git rev-parse HEAD)'
          mkdir -p _site
          pandoc bazel-bin/stardoc/stardoc.md -o _site/index.html
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3

  # Deployment job
  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
",
  "rationale": "The workflow builds Stardoc documentation using Bazel on manual dispatch. Adding a cache for Bazel's dependency and build cache (~/.cache/bazel) keyed on the workspace configuration files (MODULE.bazel, WORKSPACE) will allow reuse of downloaded dependencies and incremental build results across workflow runs, reducing build time on subsequent executions. This is supported by pattern P-LIT-BAZEL-INCREMENTAL which reports significant speedups for Bazel builds with result caching (4.22-4.71x median speedup for long compilations). The preconditions (existing Bazel build, trusted input-keyed cache) are met, and the contraindications (mutable undeclared inputs, untrusted cache writes) are mitigated by keying the cache on the declared workspace files.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-BAZEL-INCREMENTAL"]
}
